notes.title: Update 23.11.2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bug fix: Bonus Level medals were not properly displayed in the Level Select menu.
[*] Bug fix: The game complete achievement should now work, either after completing Bonus Level 3, or by entering the Level Select Menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 21.11.2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bug fix: Bonus level 2 was unsolvable. This has been fixed.
[*] Made cheat code more obvious
[/list]

notes.title: Update 20.11.2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed undo bug in bonus level 3
[*] Fixed level # display of bonus levels
[/list]

notes.title: Update 19.11.2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved keyboard control in Level Select

[list] 
[*] Level preview is now shown instantly when selecting with keyboard
[*] Double tapping enter will now start the level
[/list]
[*] Added keyboard wrap around for all menus (except Level Select)
[*] Added escape to the menus where applicable
[*] Clarified cheat code usage
[/list]

notes.title: Update 14.11.2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Level counter in the top right
[*] Added keyboard control for all menus

Known bugs in keyboard control:
[list]
[*] The scroll wheel in the resolution dropdown doesn't work.
[*] In the Level Select screen, Level 1 is not highlighted when entering the screen. This is only a graphical issue, you can still use the keyboard for selecting.
[/list]

[*] Added a go back one level button for the pause and win menu. This button does not work in bonus levels.
[*] Bug fix: When activating the optional win menu, the player could still move in the puzzle after completing it.
[/list]
